It appears to show that the demon among those who gathered to attend church mass was undergoing intense suffering from the spiritual power and authority of the sacred prayer. 

Terrifying screams were heard during the prayer as Cardinal Ernest Simoni recited Pope Leo XIII’s exorcism prayer in Latin at the Shrine of Saint Pio of Pietrelcina on Tuesday. The sudden growling was captured in a live broadcast from the shrine by the Catholic channel Padre Pio TV.

It appears to show that the demon among those who gathered to attend church mass was undergoing intense suffering from the spiritual power and authority of the sacred prayer. 

According to a Facebook page named 'uCatholic' stated that 98-year-old cardinal recited a powerful exorcism prayer against Satan. He recited Pope Leo XIII's historic prayer against Satan and the fallen angels following Mass at the Shrine of Padre Pio in San Giovanni Rotondo, Italy.

Before beginning, Cardinal Simoni invited the faithful to pray for world peace, Pope Leo XIV, and civil authorities. However, the origin of the screams remains unknown, and no supernatural explanation has been confirmed. 

¿Exorcismo en la misa en vivo? Un momento de máxima tensión espiritual quedó captado en el Santuario de San Pío de Pietrelcina, en Italia 🙏 ​Durante una ceremonia, el cardenal Ernest Simoni recitaba en latín la oración a San Miguel Arcángel —tradicionalmente con vinculación a los ritos de exorcismo— cuando se escucharon gritos y vocalizaciones que conmocionaron a los presentes y desataron interpretaciones sobre una posible manifestación demoníaca 😱 ​Un poco de contexto histórico: ​La oración: Se atribuye al papa León XIII (finales del siglo XIX), quien según la tradición católica la compuso tras tener una visión de una lucha espiritual contra las fuerzas del mal. ​El cardenal: Ernest Simoni, sacerdote albanés sobreviviente de décadas de persecución y trabajos forzados bajo el régimen comunista, es conocido por su testimonio de fe y su ministerio de oración y liberación. ​El lugar: San Giovanni Rotondo, donde vivió el Padre Pío, figura central en la devoción católica contemporánea asociada a la dirección espiritual y al combate espiritual. ​¿Cómo interpretan este tipo de episodios entre la fe, la sugestión y el rito? 👇

— La Hora (@LaHoraMX) November 20, 2026

According to EWTN News, a Catholic news outlet, the ceremony took place on November 17 and the moment was captured on video of the celebration.

What Simoni Said Before Praying

Before beginning, the cardinal invited those present to pray for world peace, for the Pope, and for world leaders. He then explained the meaning of the text and described it as a spiritual tool against evil.

“It is the most powerful prayer for peace and for eliminating all satanic forces,” Simoni stated. EWTN adds that he also associated the prayer with pleading for protection of humanity from disease, catastrophes, and armed conflict.
